facts.fact: National Treasury published the draft cross-border crypto manual for public comment until the end of September 2026, and crypto firms and lawyers (Deneys Attorneys, AltCoinTrader, VALR, Luno, BitcoinZAR Advocacy Group) commented on it; document dated 2026-08-05 and gives no earlier publication date.
facts.system: Draft Crypto Asset Manual for Cross-Border Activities

facts.fact: National Treasury published the Draft Capital Flow Management Regulations 2026, covering crypto assets, for public comment in April 2026, with comments closing at the end of June 2026.
